Three main-root calls exited1 after3135/3048/2647ms with only error "Mailbox receipt scan budget exceeded". Main advisor receipt directory has1107 entries (enumerates4ms), below source MAX_ENTRIES16384. The source read_evidence receipt loop uses a2-second wall deadline; this looks like the time limit under present IO pressure, NOT proof of entry-cap exhaustion. Sibling snapshots succeed but lack main acknowledgements, so skipping main would be unsafe. No notifications, acknowledgements, ledger/install state or source files were changed by these probes.

Artifact caveat: --version identifies that path as91071afddc+dirty built22:39, not a clean final-head binary. mailbox_wake.rs is unchanged since910 and634 source has2-second deadline/16384 cap, but do not infer full final-artifact equivalence just from directory name. Before final readiness build/identify the reviewed native artifact and run main plus cross-root READ-ONLY snapshots on current real metadata, recording artifact/source hashes and safe counts. If reproduced, fix the bounded receipt scan to handle this legitimate current1107-entry inbox under host load while retaining hard entry/byte/time limits, pinned nofollow/owner/single-link checks and exact-ID/local-watermark/unknown-private invariants. A measured host-side deadline adjustment within the20s subprocess/120s overall budgets is a bounded option; no general resolver rewrite or unbounded retries. Never delete receipts, globally acknowledge/baseline unread mail, skip an unsafe root, weaken metadata validation, or treat failed scan as empty. Pin deterministic budget-exhaustion/no-partial-success coverage and a representative receipt corpus; don't add a flaky wall-clock-only test. This is a concrete installation-readiness check, not permission for live queue calls/synthetic wakes or promotion. Current F2 install correction remains priority; report the final artifact's actual snapshot result before install.
subject: Read-only preflight: main snapshot exceeds receipt deadline; verify final native artifact
